'''Nick Stefanko'''<ref name="dt-19164">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19164 Junkyard Party], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 30 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19164/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19164/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''JediBrain''') posted a [[Light]] [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]] list on DeckTech in September 2001.
